source: proposed by claude-haiku-5-5 (group-v1) from run pilot

access.description: User cannot sign in because the app rejects their password or does not let them into their account.
access.name: Login failure

access.description: Users say too many ads prevent them from getting into or using the app.
access.name: Ads blocking entry

billing.description: Users say basic actions such as choosing, skipping, or replaying specific songs now require Premium.
billing.name: Premium-gated basic controls

billing.description: Free users say they can only skip a limited number of songs, such as six.
billing.name: Skip limit

billing.description: Free users say they cannot add songs to the queue or play the next chosen track.
billing.name: Queue restriction

catalog.description: Users report that many songs they want are not available on the platform.
catalog.name: Missing songs

catalog.description: Lyrics are inconsistently available, sometimes missing for songs.
catalog.name: Lyrics availability

catalog.description: Users say recommendations have worsened, with fewer songs or less recent music.
catalog.name: Recommendation quality

catalog.description: Users say certain genres, such as gospel music, are underrepresented.
catalog.name: Genre coverage

downloads.description: Song downloads get stuck in the background until the app is reopened.
downloads.name: Background download stuck

downloads.description: Offline listening does not work for the user.
downloads.name: Offline mode broken

other.description: Users express broad disappointment with a recent update without specifying a concrete issue.
other.name: General dissatisfaction with update

other.description: Users object to the app's content or the company's stance on certain religious, political, or social matters and say they will boycott or uninstall.
other.name: Content policy objection

other.description: Reviews consisting mainly of insults or profanity with no specific product feedback.
other.name: Abusive language

playback.description: Google Assistant reports playing a Spotify playlist but no songs actually play.
playback.name: Voice assistant no playback

playback.description: The app crashes or gets stuck on the loading or logo screen and cannot be opened.
playback.name: Crash on launch

playback.description: Playback fails on Wi-Fi while working on mobile data, and some songs have poor audio quality.
playback.name: Network connectivity failure

playback.description: Music stops partway through a track and does not resume where it left off, starting a different song instead.
playback.name: Playback stops midway

usability.description: Users complain that ads are too frequent, too loud, or appear everywhere, degrading the listening experience.
usability.name: Intrusive ads

usability.description: Users say basic player features such as going back, repeating, or playing specific parts were removed or broken.
usability.name: Removed basic controls

usability.description: Users dislike the new homescreen layout and scrolling format that shows one playlist, album, or artist at a time.
usability.name: Homescreen redesign

usability.description: Users say major interface updates are rolled out without beta testing or notice.
usability.name: Unannounced UX changes

usability.description: Users say playlists play songs randomly, disrupting their intended listening order.
usability.name: Shuffle playlist behavior
